name: Nazarin Bayanai da Spreadsheet da SQL
objectives: Idan manaja ya ba ku wata buƙatar kasuwanci, rubuta tambayar bayanai a sarari wadda za a iya auna ta, da jera bayanan da ake buƙata don amsa ta, da wane ko mene, abin aunawa da lokaci

Idan an ba ku spreadsheet mai kurakurai, tsabtace bayanan ta hanyar cire maimaitattun layuka, cire ƙarin sarari da daidaita sunaye da tsari, ba tare da sauran maimaitattun layuka ko sunaye marasa daidaito ba
Idan kuna da bayanai masu tsabta a Google Sheets ko Excel, gina pivot table da dabarar SUMIFS ko COUNTIFS da ke amsa tambayar, da jimlolin da suka yi daidai da binciken hannu
Ta amfani da editan SQL kyauta da teburin atisaye, rubuta tambayoyin SELECT da WHERE da ORDER BY da ke kawo layukan da aka nema, suna kawo ainihin layukan da suka dace a jerin da ya dace
Ta amfani da teburori biyu na atisaye, rubuta tambayoyin da ke amfani da GROUP BY tare da SUM, COUNT ko AVG, da JOIN tsakanin teburorin, da sakamakon da ya yi daidai da binciken hannu
Idan kuna da sakamakon nazarinku, rubuta sakamako uku masu lambobi, iyaka ɗaya ta bayanan da mataki ɗaya na gaba, a jimloli masu sauƙi da manaja zai iya aiki da su

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Aikin mai nazari: daga buƙata zuwa tambaya a sarari
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Rubuta tambayar bayanai a sarari wadda za a iya auna ta daga buƙatar manaja.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan manaja ya ba ku wata buƙatar kasuwanci, za ku iya rubuta tambayar bayanai a sarari wadda za a iya auna ta, da jera bayanan da ake buƙata don amsa ta, da wane ko mene, abin aunawa da lokaci.
Masu nazari suna bin hanya mai sauƙi: yin tambaya a sarari, samun bayanai, tsabtace su, nazarin su, da bayyana ma'anarsu. Yawancin aikin yana farawa daga tambayar. Buƙata marar sarari tana kawo amsa marar sarari.
Manaja ya ce, "Yaya sayarwa take tafiya?" Wannan buƙata ce, ba tambaya ba. Tambaya a sarari tana ambaton wane ko mene, abin aunawa da lokaci: "Wane ne a cikin shagunanmu uku ya fi samun kuɗin shiga daga 1 zuwa 4 ga Oktoba?" Yanzu kun san bayanan da kuke buƙata: ranaku, shaguna, yawan kaya da farashi.
Tambayoyi masu kyau ana iya auna su (za ku iya amsa su da lamba), suna da takamaimai, kuma suna da amfani (amsar tana taimaka wa wani ya yanke shawara). Ku rubuta bayanan da kuke buƙata kafin ku buɗe kowane fayil.
Ayyukan da ke amfani da waɗannan ƙwarewa sun haɗa da mai nazarin bayanai, mai nazarin rahoto, mai nazarin ayyuka da mai nazarin kasuwanci. Idan kuna son takardar shaida, CompTIA Data+ (jarabawa DA0-002 lokacin da muka duba a Oktoba 2026) tana ƙunshe da ra'ayoyin bayanai, shirya bayanai, nazari, zane-zane da rahoto, da kula da bayanai. Ku duba shafin hukuma don bayanan yanzu.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku rubuta buƙatar manajan da kalmominsa.
- Ku mayar da ita tambaya mai wane ko mene, abin aunawa da lokaci.
- Ku duba: lamba za ta iya amsa ta?
- Ku jera shafukan (columns) bayanan da kuke buƙata.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Mai nazarin bayanai (data analyst): mutumin da ke mayar da bayanai zuwa amsoshin da mutane za su iya amfani da su.
- Za a iya auna shi (measurable): za a iya amsa shi da lamba ko ƙidaya.
- Dataset (tarin bayanai): rukunin bayanai, sau da yawa tebur mai layuka da shafuka.
- Revenue (kuɗin shiga): kuɗin da ke shigowa daga sayarwa: yawan kaya sau farashi.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- CompTIA Data+ (DA0-002): shafin hukuma
Gwada yanzu: Ku mayar da kowace buƙata zuwa tambaya a sarari, ku jera bayanan da ake buƙata: (a) "Shin ma'ajiyar abinci ta agaji (food pantry) ta fi cika kwanan nan?" (b) "Wane kaya ya kamata mu ƙara oda?" Ku rubuta kowace da wane ko mene, abin aunawa da lokaci.
Yanzu za ku iya mayar da buƙata marar sarari zuwa tambaya a sarari wadda za a iya auna ta, da jera bayanan da take buƙata.

check.q: Wace ce tambayar bayanai mafi sarari?
options: "Wane kaya ne aka fi sayar da yawansa a Satumba a shagon North?"
check.why: Tana ambaton mene (kaya), abin aunawa (yawa), wuri da lokaci.

check.q: Tambayarku ita ce "Wane shago ne ya fi samun kuɗin shiga a makon jiya?" Wane bayani kuke buƙata?
options: Shago, rana, yawa da farashin kowace sayarwa
check.why: Kuɗin shiga yana buƙatar yawa da farashi; shago da rana suna raba shi bisa wuri da lokaci.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: Tsabtace bayanai masu kurakurai a spreadsheet
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Tsabtace tebur mai kurakurai ta hanyar cire maimaitattun layuka, cire sarari da gyara sunaye.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan an ba ku spreadsheet mai kurakurai, za ku iya tsabtace bayanan ta hanyar cire maimaitattun layuka, cire ƙarin sarari da daidaita sunaye da tsari, ba tare da sauran maimaitattun layuka ko sunaye marasa daidaito ba.
Bayanan gaske suna da kurakurai. Ana iya rubuta shago ɗaya a matsayin "North", "north" da " North" (da sarari). Ana iya shigar da sayarwa ɗaya sau biyu. Ranaku na iya zama da tsari daban-daban. Idan ba ku tsabtace su ba, jimlolinku za su yi kuskure, domin spreadsheet yana ɗaukar "North" da "north " a matsayin shaguna biyu daban.
A Google Sheets, ku zaɓi bayananku ku yi amfani da Data > Data cleanup > Remove duplicates, da Data > Data cleanup > Trim whitespace. A Excel, ku yi amfani da Data > Remove Duplicates, da dabarar TRIM don cire ƙarin sarari. Ku yi amfani da Find and replace don gyara sunaye, misali ku canja "north" zuwa "North".
Ku sa kowane shafi (column) ya zama iri ɗaya: ranaku a matsayin ranaku, lambobi a matsayin lambobi (ba tare da rubuta "$" ba), rubutu da rubutun kalma ɗaya kowane lokaci. Sannan ku ƙara duk shafin da kuke buƙata, kamar Revenue = Qty sau Price (misali =D2*E2).
Koyaushe ku ajiye kwafin ainihin bayanai (raw data) a shafinsa (tab) na daban, ku tsabtace kwafi. Ku rubuta kowane canji da kuka yi, don wani ya iya amincewa da aikinku ya maimaita shi.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku kwafi ainihin bayanai zuwa sabon tab mai suna Clean.
- Ku cire maimaitattun layuka.
- Ku cire ƙarin sarari.
- Ku gyara sunaye da Find and replace don kowane suna ya zama da rubutu ɗaya.
- Ku sa kowane shafi ya zama iri ɗaya: ranaku, lambobi ko rubutu.
- Ku ƙara shafukan lissafi, kamar Revenue = Qty * Price.
- Ku rubuta gajeren jerin canje-canjen da kuka yi.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Tsabtace bayanai (data cleaning): gyara kurakurai, maimaitawa da shigarwa marasa daidaito don sakamako ya yi daidai.
- Maimaitacce (duplicate): layin da ya bayyana fiye da sau ɗaya bisa kuskure.
- Whitespace (ƙarin sarari): ƙarin sarari kafin ko bayan rubutu da ba a iya gani cikin sauƙi.
- Raw data (ainihin bayanai): bayanan kamar yadda kuka karɓe su, kafin kowane canji.
Gwada yanzu: A Google Sheets, ku rubuta wannan teburin atisaye da kanun Date, Store, Item, Qty, Price: 2026-10-01, North, Coffee, 3, 2.50 / 2026-10-01, South, Bagel, 5, 1.75 / 2026-10-02, north , Bagel, 2, 1.75 / 2026-10-02, East, Coffee, 6, 2.50 / 2026-10-02, East, Coffee, 6, 2.50 / 2026-10-03, South, Coffee, 4, 2.50 / 2026-10-03, North, Juice, 1, 3.00 / 2026-10-04, East, Bagel, 8, 1.75 / 2026-10-04, South, Juice, 2, 3.00. Ku kwafe shi zuwa tab mai suna Clean, ku cire maimaitaccen layin East, ku gyara "north " zuwa "North", ku ƙara shafin Revenue. Ya kamata ku sami layuka 8.
Yanzu za ku iya tsabtace tebur mai kurakurai don kowace jimla da kuka gina a kansa ta yi daidai.

check.q: Jimlar "North" ta yi ƙasa sosai. Wasu layuka suna cewa "north " da sarari. Me za ku yi?
options: Ku cire sararin ku sa sunan ya zama "North" ko'ina
check.why: Cire sarari da gyara sunaye suna sa dukkan layukan North su ƙidayu tare.

check.q: Kafin tsabtacewa, me ya kamata ku yi da ainihin bayanai?
options: Ku aika su ta imel ga kowa
Ku ajiye kwafi a tab nasu ku tsabtace kwafi
check.why: Ajiye ainihin bayanai yana ba ku damar duba ko sake yin aikinku.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Taƙaitawa da pivot table, SUMIFS da COUNTIFS
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Gina pivot table da dabarar SUMIFS da ke amsa tambayarku.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan kuna da bayanai masu tsabta a Google Sheets ko Excel, za ku iya gina pivot table da dabarar SUMIFS ko COUNTIFS da ke amsa tambayar, da jimlolin da suka yi daidai da binciken hannu.
Pivot table yana taƙaita babban tebur cikin daƙiƙoƙi: misali, jimlar kuɗin shiga na kowane shago. A Google Sheets, ku zaɓi bayananku masu tsabta ku zaɓi Insert > Pivot table. A Excel, ku zaɓi Insert > PivotTable. Ku saka Store a ƙarƙashin Rows da Revenue a ƙarƙashin Values, an taƙaita ta SUM.
Da bayanan atisaye da aka tsabtace, pivot ɗin ya kamata ya nuna East 29.00, South 24.75 da North 14.00. Don haka East ne ya fi samun kuɗin shiga daga 1 zuwa 4 ga Oktoba.
Dabaru (formulas) suna iya amsa tambaya ɗaya a lokaci ɗaya. SUMIFS yana tara lambobin da suka dace da wata ƙa'ida: =SUMIFS(F:F, B:B, "South") yana tara shafin Revenue (F) inda shafin Store (B) ya ce South, sakamakon 24.75. COUNTIFS yana ƙidaya layukan da suka dace: =COUNTIFS(C:C, "Coffee") yana ƙidaya sayarwar Coffee, sakamakon 3. AVERAGEIFS yana aiki haka don matsakaici (average).
Koyaushe ku duba lamba ɗaya da hannu. Idan pivot ɗin da binciken hannunku ba su yi daidai ba, wataƙila bayanan har yanzu suna buƙatar tsabtacewa.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku zaɓi bayanai masu tsabta, har da kanun.
- Ku saka pivot table a sabon shafi.
- Ku saka rukunin (Store) a Rows.
- Ku saka abin aunawa (Revenue) a Values, an taƙaita ta SUM.
- Ku jera shi daga mafi girma zuwa mafi ƙanƙanta.
- Ku duba jimla ɗaya da hannu ko da SUMIFS.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Pivot table: kayan aikin da ke haɗa rukuni da taƙaita tebur, misali jimloli bisa shago.
- SUMIFS: dabarar da ke tara lambobin da suka dace da ƙa'ida ɗaya ko fiye.
- COUNTIFS: dabarar da ke ƙidaya layukan da suka dace da ƙa'ida ɗaya ko fiye.
- Abin aunawa (measure): lambar da kuke tarawa ko kuke neman matsakaicinta, kamar kuɗin shiga.
Gwada yanzu: Ta amfani da bayanan atisayenku masu tsabta, ku gina pivot table na kuɗin shiga bisa shago ku jera shi. Sannan ku rubuta SUMIFS na East da COUNTIFS na Bagel. Ku duba: East ya kamata ya zama 29.00, Bagel kuma ya ƙidaya layuka 3. Ku yi pivot na biyu na Qty bisa Item.
Yanzu za ku iya taƙaita tebur da pivot table, da duba shi da SUMIFS da COUNTIFS.

check.q: A pivot table na kuɗin shiga bisa shago, ina Store yake tafiya?
check.why: Rukunin da kuke haɗawa da shi yana tafiya a Rows; lambar da kuke tarawa tana tafiya a Values.

check.q: Wace dabara ce ke tara Revenue (shafi F) na shagon North kaɗai (shafi B)?
check.why: SUMIFS yana tara kewayon tarawa (F) inda kewayon ƙa'ida (B) ya yi daidai da North.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: SQL da bayyana sakamako

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Tambayoyinku na farko na SQL: SELECT, WHERE da ORDER BY
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Rubuta tambayoyin SELECT da WHERE da ORDER BY a editan SQL kyauta.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da editan SQL kyauta da teburin atisaye, za ku iya rubuta tambayoyin SELECT da WHERE da ORDER BY da ke kawo layukan da aka nema, suna kawo ainihin layukan da suka dace a jerin da ya dace.
Manyan ƙungiyoyi suna ajiye bayanai a rumbun bayanai (database), ba a spreadsheet ba. SQL (ana yawan furta shi "sequel") shi ne harshen yin tambayoyi ga rumbun bayanai. Query tambaya ɗaya ce. SQL yana kama da Turanci mai sauƙi, kuma kusan kowane aikin bayanai yana amfani da shi.
Kuna iya yin atisaye kyauta a burauzar ku a SQLite Online (sqliteonline.com): ku rubuta SQL a editan ku danna Run. Yana iya ba da ƙarin abubuwa na kuɗi; ba kwa buƙatar su. DB Browser for SQLite zaɓi ne kyauta na kwamfuta (open-source). Ku yi amfani da bayanan atisaye kaɗai a kayan aikin intanet, kada ku taɓa amfani da bayanan abokan ciniki na gaske.
Ku ƙirƙiri teburin atisaye ta hanyar gudanar da: CREATE TABLE sales (id INTEGER, sale_date TEXT, store TEXT, item TEXT, qty INTEGER, price REAL); sannan INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1,'2026-10-01','North','Coffee',3,2.50),(2,'2026-10-01','South','Bagel',5,1.75),(3,'2026-10-02','North','Bagel',2,1.75),(4,'2026-10-02','East','Coffee',6,2.50),(5,'2026-10-03','South','Coffee',4,2.50),(6,'2026-10-03','North','Juice',1,3.00),(7,'2026-10-04','East','Bagel',8,1.75),(8,'2026-10-04','South','Juice',2,3.00);
Yanzu ku tambaya. SELECT * FROM sales; yana nuna kowane layi. SELECT item, qty FROM sales WHERE store = 'North'; yana nuna kayan North kaɗai. SELECT * FROM sales WHERE qty >= 4 ORDER BY qty DESC; yana nuna manyan sayarwa huɗu, mafi girma da farko (8, 6, 5, 4). Rubutu yana cikin alamar ambato guda (' '); lambobi ba sa ciki.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku buɗe editan SQL kyauta a burauzar ku.
- Ku gudanar da layin CREATE TABLE, sannan layin INSERT.
- Ku gudanar da SELECT * FROM sales; don ganin dukkan layuka 8.
- Ku ƙara WHERE don ajiye layukan da kuke so kaɗai.
- Ku ƙara ORDER BY don jerawa; ku ƙara DESC don mafi girma da farko.
- Ku duba sakamakon ta hanyar kallon layukan da kanku.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Rumbun bayanai (database): ma'ajiyar bayanai mai tsari, wadda ake ajiye ta a teburori.
- SQL: Structured Query Language: harshen yin tambayoyi ga rumbun bayanai.
- Query: tambaya ɗaya da aka rubuta da SQL.
- SELECT / FROM: SELECT yana ambaton shafukan da kuke so; FROM yana ambaton teburin.
- WHERE: yana ajiye layukan da suka dace da ƙa'ida kaɗai.
- ORDER BY: yana jera sakamako; DESC yana nufin mafi girma da farko.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- SQLite Online (editan SQL a burauzar intanet)
- DB Browser for SQLite (shirin kwamfuta kyauta, open-source)
Gwada yanzu: Ku ƙirƙiri teburin sales ku gudanar da tambayoyin uku. Sannan ku rubuta naku: dukkan sayarwar Coffee, an jera bisa qty daga mafi girma zuwa mafi ƙanƙanta. Ya kamata ku sami layuka 3: qty 6, 4 da 3. Ku ajiye kowace query da sakamakonta don aikinku na ƙarshe.
Yanzu za ku iya ƙirƙirar teburin atisaye da rubuta tambayoyin SQL da ke tace da jera layuka.

check.q: Wace query ce ke nuna sayarwar shagon South kaɗai?
options: SELECT * FROM sales ORDER BY store;
check.why: WHERE store = 'South' yana ajiye layukan wannan shago kaɗai.

check.q: Me DESC yake yi a ORDER BY qty DESC?
options: Yana jerawa daga mafi girma zuwa mafi ƙanƙanta
check.why: DESC yana nufin daga sama zuwa ƙasa: mafi girma da farko.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Jimloli da GROUP BY, da haɗa teburori biyu
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Rubuta query ta GROUP BY da SUM, da JOIN tsakanin teburori biyu.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da teburori biyu na atisaye, za ku iya rubuta tambayoyin da ke amfani da GROUP BY tare da SUM, COUNT ko AVG, da JOIN tsakanin teburorin, da sakamakon da ya yi daidai da binciken hannu.
GROUP BY yana yin a SQL abin da pivot table ke yi a spreadsheet. SELECT store, SUM(qty * price) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY store ORDER BY revenue DESC; yana ba da East 29.0, South 24.75, North 14.0, daidai da pivot ɗinku. AS yana ba sabon shafin suna.
Wasu ayyukan taƙaitawa: COUNT(*) yana ƙidaya layuka, AVG(qty) yana ba da matsakaici, MIN da MAX suna ba da mafi ƙanƙanta da mafi girma. SELECT item, SUM(qty) FROM sales GROUP BY item; yana ba da Bagel 15, Coffee 13, Juice 3.
Sau da yawa ana raba bayanai a teburori daban-daban. Tebur na biyu zai iya ɗauke da birnin kowane shago: CREATE TABLE stores (store TEXT, city TEXT); INSERT INTO stores VALUES ('North','Fresno'),('South','Bakersfield'),('East','Modesto'); JOIN yana haɗa layukan da wani shafi ya yi daidai a teburorin biyu.
SELECT sales.item, sales.qty, stores.city FROM sales JOIN stores ON sales.store = stores.store; yana nuna kowace sayarwa da birninta. Idan an rubuta sunan shago daban a teburorin biyu, JOIN ɗin zai tsallake shi, wanda wani dalili ne na tsabtace bayanai da farko.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku zaɓi shafin da za ku haɗa rukuni da shi (store, item, date).
- Ku zaɓi taƙaitawa: SUM, COUNT, AVG, MIN ko MAX.
- Ku rubuta SELECT column, SUM(...) AS name FROM table GROUP BY column;
- Ku ƙara ORDER BY don jera rukunonin.
- Don JOIN, ku ambaci teburorin biyu da shafin da ya yi daidai bayan ON.
- Ku kwatanta sakamakon da pivot table ɗinku.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- GROUP BY: yana haɗa layukan da ke da daraja ɗaya don ku tara ko ku ƙidaya kowane rukuni.
- Aikin taƙaitawa (aggregate function): taƙaitawa kamar SUM, COUNT, AVG, MIN ko MAX.
- AS: yana ba shafin sakamako suna.
- JOIN: yana haɗa layuka daga teburori biyu da ke da shafi mai daraja ɗaya.
- Key (maɓalli): shafin da ake amfani da shi don haɗa layuka tsakanin teburori.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- SQLite Online (editan SQL a burauzar intanet)
Gwada yanzu: Ku gudanar da query ta GROUP BY ta kuɗin shiga ku duba ta yi daidai da pivot table ɗinku. Ku rubuta query da ke ƙidaya sayarwa a kowane shago (COUNT(*)); ya kamata ku sami 3, 3 da 2. Sannan ku ƙirƙiri teburin stores ku gudanar da JOIN. Ku ajiye kowace query da sakamakonta.
Yanzu za ku iya tara da ƙidaya rukunoni da GROUP BY, da haɗa teburori biyu da JOIN.

check.q: Wace query ce ke ba da jimlar yawan kayan da aka sayar na kowane item?
options: SELECT item, SUM(qty) FROM sales GROUP BY item;
SELECT item FROM sales WHERE qty = SUM;
check.why: GROUP BY item yana yin rukuni ɗaya ga kowane item, SUM(qty) kuma yana tara kowanne.

check.q: JOIN tsakanin sales da stores yana tsallake layukan North. Mene ne dalili mafi yiwuwa?
options: SQL ba ya iya haɗa rubutu
An rubuta sunan shagon daban a teburorin biyu
JOIN yana aiki ranar Litinin kaɗai
check.why: JOIN yana haɗa daraja iri ɗaya daidai; rubutu daban-daban ba sa haɗuwa.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Mayar da sakamako zuwa bayanan binciken, da aikinku
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Rubuta sakamako uku masu lambobi, iyaka ɗaya da mataki ɗaya na gaba.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan kuna da sakamakon nazarinku, za ku iya rubuta sakamako uku masu lambobi, iyaka ɗaya ta bayanan da mataki ɗaya na gaba, a jimloli masu sauƙi da manaja zai iya aiki da su.
Lambobi kaɗai ba sa taimakon manaja. Sakamako (finding) jimla ɗaya ce da ke faɗin abin da bayanan suka nuna, tare da lambar: "East ne ya fi samun kuɗin shiga daga 1 zuwa 4 ga Oktoba: $29.00, fiye da ninki biyu na $14.00 na North."
Ku faɗi gaskiya game da iyakoki. Bayanan atisaye sun ƙunshi kwanaki 4 da sayarwa 8 kawai, don haka ba za su iya faɗa muku game da shekara guda ba. Tafiya tare (correlation) ba dalili ba ce: idan Coffee ya fi sayuwa a rana mai sanyi, bayanan kaɗai ba su tabbatar da cewa sanyin ne ya jawo shi ba. Ku faɗi abin da bayanan ba za su iya faɗa ba.
Ku ƙare da mataki na gaba da wani zai iya aiki da shi: "Ku tattara sayarwar wata guda cikakke kafin ku yanke shawarar inda za ku ƙara tura kaya." Ku ajiye shi a shafi ɗaya, da zane (chart) ko tebur ɗaya mai sarari daga pivot ɗinku.
A ƙarshe, ku mayar da aikin zuwa layin résumé: "Cleaned and analyzed sales data in Google Sheets and SQL (GROUP BY, JOIN); found the top store by revenue and reported findings." (Na tsabtace da nazarin bayanan sayarwa a Google Sheets da SQL; na gano shagon da ya fi kuɗin shiga na bayar da rahoto.) Wannan yana nuna wa mai ɗaukar aiki abin da za ku iya yi. Ku yi amfani da bayanai ƙirƙirarru ko na jama'a kaɗai a portfolio, kada ku taɓa amfani da bayanan sirri na mai ɗaukar aiki.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku rubuta tambayar a sama.
- Ku ƙara tebur ko zane ɗaya daga pivot ɗinku.
- Ku rubuta sakamako uku, kowanne da lamba.
- Ku rubuta iyaka ɗaya: abin da bayanan ba za su iya faɗa ba.
- Ku rubuta mataki ɗaya na gaba.
- Ku ƙara tambayoyin SQL ɗinku da sakamakonsu.
- Ku rubuta layin résumé ɗaya game da aikin.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Sakamako (finding): jimla ɗaya da ke faɗin abin da bayanan suka nuna, tare da lamba.
- Iyaka (limitation): abin da bayanan ba za su iya faɗa ba, ko dalilin yin hankali da su.
